design.question: Is RS189 actually the best stock-strength horizon for early leader capture, separating eligibility from ranking?
design.leader_kpi: Primary = fixed annual Top10 and rolling126 superleaders; target concept = >=80% capture and entry by <=20% of the leader move.
design.stage1: No RS eligibility gate: common price/liquidity/trend structural pool; compare early top12/top20 identification across horizons and non-RS neighbors.
design.stage2: 9 Core + 3 Emerging, SELECTIVE 3+1, current Emerging MILD sleeve and exits unchanged; only Core eligibility/ranking varies.
design.important: Leader labels are hindsight evaluation-only, frozen before simulations, never used by a signal.
